verdict.rationale: Chunked output for retrieval pipelines is a fair question for a web-data and scraping platform like Apify, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents dataset exports (CSV, JSON, XLSX, XML), pagination limits and Pandas loading. Nothing shows a semantic chunking option, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
